facts.text: American Flag was deployed at Hadley Rille during Apollo 15 in 1971.
Planted during EVA-1 with the Hadley Delta mountain and Hadley Rille visible in the background. One of the most photographed flag plantings of the programme.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Provided a photographic reference point documenting the dramatic terrain at Hadley-Apennine, the most geologically complex Apollo landing site.
LROC images from 2011 confirmed the Apollo 15 flag is still standing, casting a visible shadow on the surface.
